title: Housecall Pro CSR AI Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: Housecall Pro CSR AI Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare Housecall Pro CSR AI alternatives: Off The Clock AI, Sameday, Avoca and Jobber. Service pricing, website quotes and platform choices.
intro: A booking on the calendar is useful. A customer who already understands the job price is further along.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock when you want the price question handled before it becomes another estimate appointment. QuoteDone brings your rates and the customer’s job details into an operator that also answers, books and follows up.
reason: Housecall Pro’s guidance explicitly says CSR AI references the set price of an available service. It also uses service descriptions to explain inclusions. [[hcp-practices]]

A set service price and a variable project calculation are not the same task. A painting request with walls, ceilings and trim needs the selected scope and its relevant measurements—not one general painting line item.

QuoteDone is the reason to choose Off The Clock for that task. It applies your own pricing to supported job details on the phone and in the website quote widget. The surrounding operator handles questions, bookings, transfers and follow-up.
choices: The job price, not just the appointment

A dedicated quote widget is more specific than a general chat box: it collects the job details needed for the supported pricing path. Required facts stay unknown when the customer does not have them; a complete owner-review request replaces an unsupported price.

Sameday offers phones, AI CSRs, connected scheduling and campaigns. Its published minute plans provide an entry price. Compatibility with a specific HCP setup must be established separately; the published list of product features alone does not establish an HCP connection. [[sameday-product]] [[sameday-pricing]]
Call coaching and contextual human escalation

Avoca adds call assessment and a documented trained-human program to its inbound offer. Those functions address supervision and handoffs rather than making website chat equivalent to a project quote. HCP compatibility remains setup-specific. [[avoca-coach]] [[avoca-human]]

Jobber Receptionist operates in a Jobber account. It belongs in this comparison as a platform alternative, not as a plug-in for HCP. Its low add-on amount cannot be separated from the underlying platform decision. [[jobber-help]]
decision: Choose Off The Clock to move the conversation from “someone will quote that” to a supported job price or a complete request you can verify. Your customers get a clear next step, and you keep control of both the price and the exceptions.
faqs: Can Housecall Pro CSR AI book appointments and share prices?
Its guidance describes available services, set prices and Online Booking settings. Availability and permissions govern the actual booking. [[hcp-practices]]
Is a website chat widget the same as QuoteDone?

No. Chat is a communication channel. QuoteDone is the dedicated owner-priced quote workflow. HCP does offer website chat; that fact alone does not establish the same multi-input project calculation. [[hcp-chat]]
card_description: HCP can share configured service prices and handle website chat. Compare that with QuoteDone’s measured job scope and dedicated quote widget.
sections: Website chat and website quoting serve different intentions
HCP documents CSR AI Chat Answering for website conversations and booking, using the business’s CSR settings. Website communication is therefore not an absent feature. [[hcp-chat]]

QuoteDone’s website entry point is specifically for the price question. A visitor can describe the supported job and its scope without making a call. The owner’s pricing rules remain the basis; the widget is not a second set of generic prices.
The cost of the change is visible

Housecall Pro describes CSR AI answering as an optional add-on; the reviewed official documentation does not establish its numerical price. It is a separate purchase from the included AI teammates. [[hcp-team]]

Off The Clock’s QuoteDone offer is $279 per month with 1,200 minutes, the operator and website quote widget. Additional usage is $0.35 per minute, with no setup fee. It is a separate operator offer, not a replacement HCP subscription or a native HCP connector.
